topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Hallmarks of Cancer Framework
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session's learning objectives, previous lecture context, and the overarching framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Sustained Proliferative and Growth Factor Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how genetic mutations dysregulate major signaling pathways to drive continuous cell proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Malignancies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how oncogenic alterations prevent cells from undergoing normal terminal differentiation across hematological and epithelial cancers.

topics.label: Evasion of Apoptotic Cell Death
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores the molecular circuitry and regulatory proteins that allow cancer cells to resist apoptosis.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence Bypass
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the mechanisms by which tumor cells overcome finite cell division limits through telomere maintenance and evasion of stress-induced senescence.

topics.label: Reprogramming of Cancer Metabolism
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how tumor cells alter their metabolic pathways and Krebs cycle enzymes to support biosynthetic demands.

topics.label: Induction of Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic discusses the physiological triggers, timing, and molecular balance governing new blood vessel recruitment in developing tumors.

topics.label: Metastatic Dissemination and Colonization
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the biological hurdles, circulatory routes, clonal genetics, and clinical detection of metastatic cancer spread.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Summary
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session by summarizing the core takeaways, recommending further reading, and opening the floor to questions.
